SwordfishStabService itself refuses a stunned sender, a sender in a Seeker session and, through RoundParticipants.SWORDFISH_TARGET, a Rift occupant (an alive spectator); it checks no daze, so DAZE is a new refusal while STUN, SEEKER and RIFT no longer rest on the handler (decided 2026-11-13: owner asked for the inconsistency to be fixed; rule chosen by the maintainer agent). HYPNOSIS_EXTRA and CARRY_EXTRA deny: an item release from a charge started before the lock (NatsumeHypnosisGuards and PartygoerCarry Javadocs); now redundant with STUN and DAZE and kept on purpose. DUEL_WEAPON: the Fisher's swordfish stab (KnightContractTest).
note_zh: 钓鱼佬剑鱼蓄力松手刺击。SAFE_TIME、STUN、SEEKER、RIFT 与 DAZE 拦截：蓄力松手的武器刺击，与 wathe:knifestab 完全同样归类；FEAR 放行同样跟随小刀（SwordfishStabService.canUse：可转交的武器而非职业技能）。SwordfishStabService 自行拒绝被眩晕的发送者、处于搜寻者会话的发送者，并经 RoundParticipants.SWORDFISH_TARGET 拒绝裂隙门内玩家（活着的旁观者）；它不检查饕餮眩晕，因此 DAZE 是新的拒绝，而 STUN、SEEKER 与 RIFT 不再依赖处理器（2026-11-13 决定：所有者要求修正此不一致；规则由维护代理选定）。HYPNOSIS_EXTRA 与 CARRY_EXTRA 拦截：在锁生效前开始蓄力、之后松手的道具动作（NatsumeHypnosisGuards 与 PartygoerCarry Javadoc）；现与 STUN、DAZE 重复，有意保留。DUEL_WEAPON：钓鱼佬的剑鱼刺击（KnightContractTest）。
